paragraphs: I'm excited to apply for the Security Engineer position at PrizePicks. Your commitment to reimagining the DFS industry through robust security practices aligns perfectly with my passion and expertise in this field.

My experience includes conducting regular security assessments, managing risk assessments for third-party vendors, and educating staff on information security through training programs. I have a strong understanding of compliance standards such as SOC2, ISO 27001, and US Data Privacy, and am familiar with tools like Vanta, SecureFrame, and Asana.

In my previous role, I automated the end-to-end workflow from data aggregation to remediation, reducing manual effort by over 100 hours per month. This project improved visibility and response capabilities across thousands of endpoints, demonstrating my ability to implement scalable security solutions.
I am confident in my ability to contribute to your team's mission of securing digital assets through monitoring and tooling to prevent data loss and protect against insider threats and attacks.
